name: KEEP LEFT
spec: white vertical rectangle with black legend KEEP LEFT and an arrow curving left around a black vertical obstruction bar
meaning: Stay to the left of the divider or obstruction ahead.

snippets.back: Cross only through full clear widths, pause solely in fitting medians, keep left paths and greens truly open under ticket threat, trust no blinker until it turns, and never halt atop rails.

Avoid tailgating commercial motor vehicles, leave room and keep left in your lane for visibility when stopped behind one on an upgrade in case it drifts backward on startup, and keep high beams off when following one at night.
A Keep Left sign means traffic should go only to the left of a road feature or obstruction.
Keep Left and Keep Right signs direct the side on which a driver must proceed.
Roadway walkers keep left facing traffic, cross at intersections using provided crosswalks, and obey applicable traffic laws.
